note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The United States attacking flotilla and Spanish defenders are explicit in the Nipe Bay account. Annapolis and Jorge Juan provide equipment components, not exhaustive fleet compositions or a reconstruction of the shore defences. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Annapolis represents the United States sail-and-steam gunboat component, and the screw aviso Jorge Juan represents Spain. The Madrid Naval Museum model documents Jorge Juan’s screw, three-masted rig and central funnel. The analogy does not reconstruct every vessel, the harbour batteries, or exact rigs; no complete opposing fleet totals are asserted.
